title: Introduce RAG Playbook Simulator and Compact Authoring Kit
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds an interactive playbook simulator for RAG scenarios plus a compact authoring kit and onboarding quickstart for new users.
description: Motivation: onboarding teams struggle to iterate on RAG playbooks without a lightweight local runner that mirrors Redwood's execution semantics. This PR introduces a compact Playbook Simulator (playbook-sim) and a small authoring kit to accelerate iterative authoring and smoke e2e testing. What it contains: 1) playbook-sim/runner: a node-based simulator that interprets playbook step graphs, executes stubbed tool calls, and supports snapshot/replay for deterministic e2e checks; 2) authoring/compact-ui: a minimal web UI (React) showing step sequencing, scenario presets, and telemetry probe toggles for quick validation; 3) docs/quickstarts/playbook-sim-quickstart.md: single-page quickstart integrated into the docs site with copy-paste examples and troubleshooting notes; 4) telemetry/probes: small SDK hooks for emitting compact probes used by the Console smoke harness; 5) tests/smoke: two deterministic replay fixtures used by CI. Migration/compat: simulator follows the playbook JSON v0.3 schema and includes a compatibility shim for older v0.2 snippets. Checklist: [x] add runner and replay snapshots; [x] add compact UI and example presets; [x] write quickstart and diagrams; [x] add CI smoke tests; [x] add Linear links and changelog note. Links: quickstart preview https://redwood.dev/docs/playbook-sim (staged), Linear ENG-7342. How to use: clone repo; cd redwood-examples/playbook-sim; yarn install; yarn dev to run UI and yarn smoke to run deterministic replay. Security: authoring UI runs locally only by default, telemetry is opt-in and documented. Follow-ups: add TypeScript SDK bindings for programmatic playbook generation (ENG-7428).
